scope: Ideal simulated effort task. Go2 is now a source; A1 and five legs are development transfer probes.

protocol.teacher_selection: Fixed final checkpoint at 500 updates; continuation, if needed, is a separately reported stage.
protocol.task: The unchanged ideal-effort Go2 transfer task; 480 Hz physics / 60 Hz control.
protocol.new_data_scope: Go2 only; no A1 or reserved five-leg data for fitting.

continuation_protocol.reason: 500-update policy survived 16 s but had near-zero progress; stability only emerged late.
continuation_protocol.changes: No network, reward, task, action-rate or PPO setting changes.

comparison_protocol.normalization: Each condition uses its training demonstrations only; normalization differs between source sets.
comparison_protocol.selection: Minimum validation MSE; target rollout data never selects checkpoints.
comparison_protocol.comparison: Equal Go2 sample presentations; joint fit additionally fits equal Ant3/Ant4 batches. Not equal total compute.

cost.note: Historical Ant teachers and demonstrations reused; all new training seed 42. Wall times reflect changing workstation load.
